title: Which Loopholes Get Found? Predicting Reward Hacking of LLM Judges Before RL Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.29651v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A policy trained against an LLM judge can learn to exploit its loopholes. Static probes show that such judges accept degenerate answers like a lone "{" or "Thought process:", but not which flaw a policy will find. In GRPO the first loophole to be exploited can be predicted before training from each pattern's exposure, the product of the starting policy's propensity to produce it and the judge's false-positive rate (FPR). To test exposure causally, we seed the patterns into fine-tuning at three doses in a Latin square. Across 36 GRPO runs with seven judges, the first exploited pattern had the highest exposure in all 12 runs with exploitation and the highest FPR in only 6. Predictions recorded before training held in three of four runs with one pattern masked by rule. When only two patterns were seeded, at 3% to 3.8% of the fine-tuning data and chosen so that exposure disagreed with FPR alone or propensity alone, exposure named the first

translated_title: 哪些漏洞会被发现？在强化学习训练前预测 LLM 裁判的奖励劫持
translated_abstract: 针对 LLM 裁判训练的策略可以学会利用其漏洞。静态探测显示，这类裁判会接受诸如单独一个 "{" 或 "Thought process:" 之类的退化答案，但无法判断策略会找出哪个缺陷。在 GRPO 中，第一个被利用的漏洞可以在训练之前通过每个模式的“暴露度”（exposure）来预测——暴露度是初始策略产生该模式的倾向性与裁判假阳性率（FPR）的乘积。为了因果性地检验暴露度这一指标，我们在拉丁方设计中以三种剂量将这些模式植入微调数据。在涉及七个裁判的 36 次 GRPO 运行中，在发生漏洞利用的全部 12 次运行里，首个被利用的模式都恰好是暴露度最高的那个，而仅在 6 次运行中具有最高的假阳性率。在其中一个模式被规则遮蔽的四次运行中，训练前记录的预测有三次成立。当仅植入两个模式时（占微调数据的 3% 至 3.8%，并特意选择使暴露度与仅依据假阳性率或仅依据倾向性得出的预测不一致的情形），暴露度正确指出了第一个被利用的模式
tldr: 该论文提出“暴露度”指标（初始策略产生缺陷模式的倾向性 × 裁判假阳性率），能够在强化学习训练开始前预测 GRPO 训练中 LLM 裁判会被策略最先利用哪个漏洞。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an "exposure" metric (the product of the starting policy's propensity to produce a flawed pattern and the judge's false-positive rate) that predicts, before RL training begins, which loophole a policy will first exploit in an LLM judge during GRPO.
